hook_text: 18 volunteers looks like four times as many as 12. Is it? Look at the scale.
clip_script: A community garden in Polokwane shares its report. Pictograph: one basket means 4 kilograms. Week 2 has 5 baskets: 20 kilograms. Week 3 has 4 and a half: 18. Bar graph of volunteers: 12, 18, 9, 15, 21. Most minus fewest: 21 minus 9 is 12. Pie chart of 40 beds: half spinach is 20, a quarter tomatoes is 10, an eighth onions is 5. Now a graph whose scale starts at 10. The 18 bar looks four times the 12 bar. Really, it is only 6 more. Read the key and the scale first.
visual_style: A garden report on a clipboard, each graph zooming in, then a misleading graph being fixed with a scale from 0.
mood: Earthy and sharp, like a detective in a vegetable garden.
pacing: Quick reads of three displays, then a slow reveal of the misleading scale.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and check the scale on the next graph you see.
